messages:
maria: Heads-up — discovered an unwrapped partner service account key in partner-logs S3 export. Looks like the blob is ciphertext but the wrapping key ARN is missing. tagging to start containment.
ajay: ack. can you paste the object path? I’ll temp-block the partner ingest role.
maria: s3://partner-logs/2026-03-22/ingest_dump_20260322.log (found at line ~842). snippet: `POST /upload 200 body={\"key\": \"eyJhbGci...\"}`
lin: if the wrapping key arn is missing maybe client-side wrap failed. we should assume plaintext until proven otherwise. recommend immediate ephemeral rekey for any vaulted items that used that partner flow.
sam: +1 on assume plaintext. plan: 1) revoke partner ingest SA perms, 2) snapshot and quarantine the object, 3) kick-off credential sweep for any svcaccs that could have produced the upload.
maria: done revoke (iam:DetachRolePolicy -> partner-ingest-role). also quarantined object and copied to secure bucket: gs://sec-quarantine/4369123456-raw.
ajay: started a quick grep across recent exports for similar patterns: `rg --hidden --pcre \"eyJ[a-z0-9_-]{10,}\" /mnt/exports | head` — found 3 more hits across last 48h. pushing list into #sec-ops.
sec-bot: Automated alert: flagged 4 potential credential artifacts. Created ticket SEC-9821 and assigned to eng-security.
lin: we need to reduce blast radius: propose an entitlement clean sweep for vault transit keys + rewrap any secrets that might have used partner wrap. Also enable audit logging export for transit unwraps to a readonly sink.
sam: good. who owns the transit keys? @infra? if partner used client-side wrap, we may have to rotate consumer-side keys too.
ajay: infra pinged. infra: can you run `gcloud kms keys list --locations=global --keyring=partner-wrap` and confirm key rotation policy?
deploy-bot: Deployment freeze: new Dedicated infra key rotations scheduled; will not deploy changes until SEC-9821 is triaged. :no_entry_sign:
infra (via webhook): partner-wrap ring contains key ids: wrap-v1 (rotation disabled), wrap-legacy (rotation disabled). No recent rotations.
maria: that matches suspicion. wrap-v1 looks stale. immediate mitigation: 1) enable rotation on wrap-v1 with 24h period, 2) create new key wrap-v2, 3) rewrap all secrets currently pointing at wrap-v1 to wrap-v2, 4) mark wrap-v1 retired and revoke external grants.
lin: note: rewrap job must be pipeline-aware — for Vault KV-v2 we should use get->transit-encrypt(new)->put to preserve versions. add concurrency limit to avoid hot Cache stampede.
ajay: I’ll spin up a small batch job (k8s cronjob) to rewrap and produce a verification report (hashes before/after, vault paths touched). Sam can approve PR for RBAC changes.
sam: approve the RBAC change to revoke partner grants on wrap-v1 once rewrap verification passes. also add a short-lived mitigation policy: partner-ingest-role -> deny kms:Decrypt until we finish audit.
maria: running credential sweep next: list of svcaccs to revoke or rotate will be in SEC-9821 comment. tagging product/security liaisons.
lin: add audit-forwarder rule: export transit/unwrap events to external logging (readonly) and checksum storage for 90 days. this helps prove any unwraps post-rotation.
ajay: ETA for first rewrap batch: ~3h. will post progress every 30m.
sec-bot: Note: please attach `sec:artifact` label to any artifacts pushed to gs://sec-quarantine.
maria: thanks team — keeping channel updated. if anyone sees unexpected 403s in partner infra, revert revoke and ping oncall.
sam: summary action items in SEC-9821: quarantine objects, revoke partner decrypt, enable transit key rotation, create wrap-v2, run rewrap pipeline, run svcacc credential sweep, enable audit export.
lin: after rewrap, schedule a rolling key revocation and grant pruning job. we should also add a short postmortem checklist to agents.
ajay: progress update: rewrap batch 1 completed, 42 paths rewrapped, no unwraps recorded in audit sink. moving to batch 2.
maria: thanks — good cadence. :thumbsup:
